name: UpdateExperimentPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated dataset
parameters.name: dataset_id

fields.help_en: The runtime configuration of the evaluator. For inline LLM evaluators, this must include configurations such as prompt. When referencing an existing evaluator, this parameter is typically not required and should only be specified when runtime parameters such as version need to be set
fields.help_zh: 评估器运行配置。内联 LLM 评估器需要包含 prompt 等配置；引用已有评估器时通常不传，仅在需要指定版本等运行时参数时传入
fields.name: config

fields.help_en: The reference name of a registered evaluator. When specified, the evaluator definition is loaded by this reference with higher priority. Both built-in evaluators and custom evaluators are supported
fields.help_zh: 已注册评估器的引用名称。传入后优先按该引用加载评估器定义，支持内置评估器和自定义评估器
fields.name: evaluator_ref

fields.help_en: The evaluator-level data filter conditions. These take effect together with the task-level dataFilter.query
fields.help_zh: 评估器级数据筛选条件，会与任务级 dataFilter.query 共同生效
fields.name: filters

fields.help_en: The evaluator name. Required for inline evaluators when evaluatorRef is not specified. The evaluatorRef or name must be unique within the same task
fields.help_zh: 评估器名称。未传 evaluatorRef 的内联评估器场景必填；同一任务内 evaluatorRef 或 name 不能重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The field name for the evaluation result. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the metricName defined in the evaluator definition is used if this parameter is not specified
fields.help_zh: 评估结果字段名。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传则使用评估器定义中的 metricName
fields.name: result_name

fields.help_en: The evaluation result type. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, defaults to score if not specified
fields.help_zh: 评估结果类型。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传默认为 score
fields.name: result_type

fields.help_en: The evaluator type. Defaults to LLM if not specified. Inline CODE evaluators are not currently supported. For the CODE type, reference a previously created evaluator by using evaluatorRef
fields.help_zh: 评估器类型。未传时默认 LLM；内联 CODE 评估器当前不支持，CODE 类型请通过 evaluatorRef 引用已创建评估器
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The variable extraction rule mapping that maps evaluator variables to a portion of the content within an evaluation data field. This is applicable when the variable value is not the entire field but a subset of the field content. This parameter shares the same variable name key space as variableMapping. Each variable can use only one of the two. Duplicate configurations cause an error. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition. Call ListTraceFieldExtractionsPreview to perform a trial run for validation before saving
fields.help_zh: 变量提取规则映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段内容中的一部分，适用于变量值不是整个字段、而是字段内容里的一小块的场景。与 variableMapping 共用同一变量名键空间，同一变量只能二选一，重复配置会报错；引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中。可先调用 ListTraceFieldExtractionsPreview 试跑验证后再保存
fields.name: variable_extractor_mapping

fields.help_en: The extraction expression. Its meaning is determined by type. When type is jsonpath, specify a JSONPath expression. You can use either a relative path relative to originField (such as $.order.expected) or an absolute path from the root (such as $trace.output.order.expected). When type is regex, specify a regular expression. Note that backslashes must be escaped in JSON. The expression syntax is validated upon saving. For regular expressions, RE2 compatibility is additionally validated. Patterns such as lookahead assertions, lookbehind assertions, backreferences, named groups, atomic groups, and possessive quantifiers are rejected
fields.help_zh: 提取表达式，含义由 type 决定。type=jsonpath 时填 JSONPath，既可写相对于 originField 的相对路径（$.order.expected），也可写从根开始的绝对路径（$trace.output.order.expected）；type=regex 时填正则表达式，注意 JSON 中反斜杠需转义。保存时会校验表达式语法，正则还会额外校验 RE2 兼容性，前后向断言、反向引用、命名组、原子组、占有量词等写法会被拒绝
fields.name: expression

fields.help_en: The evaluation data field from which content is extracted. The extraction expression is applied to the content of this field. Required when saving with the evaluation task. For the trial run API, this parameter can be omitted and the backend derives it from the expression. Multiple variables can share the same source field
fields.help_zh: 被提取的评估数据字段，提取表达式作用于该字段的内容。随评估任务保存时必填（试跑接口可缺省，由后端从表达式推导）；多个变量可以共用同一个源字段
fields.name: origin_field

fields.help_en: The extraction method. jsonpath extracts values from the JSON content of the field by using JSONPath. regex performs regular expression matching on the full text of the field. When capturing groups are present, the first capturing group is returned. When no capturing group is present, the entire match is returned
fields.help_zh: 提取方式。jsonpath 表示在字段的 JSON 内容上按 JSONPath 取值；regex 表示在字段的完整文本上按正则匹配，含捕获组时取第一个捕获组，不含捕获组时取整段匹配
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The variable mapping that maps evaluator variables to evaluation data fields. Required for LLM/AGENT inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition
fields.help_zh: 变量映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段。LLM/AGENT 内联评估器必填，引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中
fields.name: variable_mapping

parameters.help_en: The list of evaluators. If omitted, the list is not modified. If an empty array is passed, the list is cleared. When configured, evaluation is automatically triggered upon experiment completion
parameters.help_zh: 评估器列表。省略表示不修改；传空数组表示清空
parameters.name: evaluators

parameters.help_en: The type of the experiment. Valid values: OFFLINE (offline experiment) and ONLINE (online experiment)
parameters.name: experiment_type

fields.help_en: The endpoint connector ID, which is required in user or agent mode
fields.help_zh: 端点连接器ID（user/agent模式时必填）
fields.name: endpoint_connector_id

fields.help_en: The experiment label (A, B, C, D, or E)
fields.help_zh: 实验标签（A/B/C/D/E）
fields.name: label

fields.help_en: The model name, which can be set to agent for agent scenarios
fields.help_zh: 模型名称（agent场景可填agent）
fields.name: model_name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable explicit caching for system messages
fields.help_zh: 是否对system消息启用显式缓存
fields.name: enable_cache_control

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable thinking mode. This takes effect only for hybrid thinking models and defaults to false if not specified
fields.help_zh: 是否开启思考模式，仅混合思考模型生效，不传时默认false
fields.name: enable_thinking

fields.help_en: The extended parameters, which are a serialized string of a JSON object. These are merged into the top level of the model request body to pass through other Model Studio parameters
fields.help_zh: 扩展参数，JSON对象序列化后的字符串，合并到模型请求体顶层，用于透传百炼其他参数
fields.name: extra_body

fields.help_en: The frequency penalty where positive values reduce repetition, with a range of -2.0 to 2.0
fields.help_zh: 频率惩罚，正值减少重复，范围-2.0到2.0
fields.name: frequency_penalty

fields.help_en: The maximum number of output tokens, including the chain-of-thought and the response. This is recommended for thinking models
fields.help_zh: 最大输出Token数，包含思维链与回答，思考模型推荐使用
fields.name: max_completion_tokens

fields.help_en: The maximum number of output tokens
fields.help_zh: 最大输出Token数
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_en: The presence penalty where positive values encourage new topics, with a range of -2.0 to 2.0
fields.help_zh: 存在惩罚，正值鼓励新话题，范围-2.0到2.0
fields.name: presence_penalty

fields.help_en: The reasoning effort level. This takes effect only when thinking mode is enabled. For the Qwen3.8 series, valid values are low, medium, and xhigh. This cannot be set simultaneously with thinkingBudget
fields.help_zh: 推理力度，仅开启思考时生效，qwen3.8系列可选low、medium、xhigh，不可与thinkingBudget同时设置
fields.name: reasoning_effort

fields.help_en: The repetition penalty that controls the repetition of consecutive sequences. The value must be greater than 0. A value of 1.0 indicates no penalty, and a larger value results in less repetition
fields.help_zh: 重复惩罚，控制连续序列重复度，取值大于0，1.0表示不惩罚，值越大重复越少
fields.name: repetition_penalty

fields.help_en: The schema name
fields.help_zh: Schema名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The JSON Schema definition, which is a serialized string of a JSON object
fields.help_zh: JSON Schema定义，JSON对象序列化后的字符串
fields.name: schema

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to strictly adhere to the schema structure. Set this to true
fields.help_zh: 是否严格遵循Schema结构，推荐true
fields.name: strict

fields.help_en: The JSON Schema constraint, which is required when the type is json_schema
fields.help_zh: JSON Schema约束，type为json_schema时必填
fields.name: json_schema

fields.help_en: The format type. Valid values: text, json_object, and json_schema. When using json_object, the prompt must explicitly request JSON output
fields.help_zh: 格式类型：text、json_object、json_schema；使用json_object时提示词中须明确要求输出JSON
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The response content format, which defaults to text if not specified
fields.help_zh: 返回内容格式，不传时默认为text
fields.name: response_format

fields.help_en: The random seed, with a range of 0 to 2147483647, which attempts to return the same result for the same input and parameters
fields.help_zh: 随机数种子，范围0-2147483647，相同输入与参数下尽量返回相同结果
fields.name: seed

fields.help_en: The stop sequences that immediately halt generation when encountered
fields.help_zh: 停止序列，遇到时立即停止生成
fields.name: stop_sequences

fields.help_en: The temperature parameter that controls the randomness of the output, with a range of 0 to 2
fields.help_zh: 温度参数，控制输出随机性，范围0-2
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: The maximum number of tokens for the thinking process. This takes effect only when thinking mode is enabled and cannot be set simultaneously with reasoningEffort
fields.help_zh: 思考过程最大Token数，仅开启思考时生效，不可与reasoningEffort同时设置
fields.name: thinking_budget

fields.help_en: The Top K sampling parameter, with a range of 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: Top K 采样参数，范围1-100
fields.name: topk

fields.help_en: The Top P sampling parameter, with a range of 0 to 1
fields.help_zh: Top P 采样参数，范围0-1
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: The model generation parameters used to control the output length, randomness, sampling range, repetition penalty, and stop sequences
fields.help_zh: 模型生成参数，用于控制输出长度、随机性、采样范围、重复惩罚和停止序列
fields.name: model_parameters

fields.help_en: The model provider. Valid values: dashscope (default), user, and agent
fields.help_zh: 模型提供商：dashscope（默认）/ user / agent
fields.name: model_provider

fields.help_en: The experiment name
fields.help_zh: 实验名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The content, which supports {{variable name}} placeholders
fields.help_zh: 内容，支持{{变量名}}占位符
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The role: system/user/assistant
fields.help_zh: 角色：system/user/assistant
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: The prompt message template, which supports {{variable name}} placeholders
fields.help_zh: Prompt消息模板，支持{{变量名}}占位符
fields.name: prompt_template

fields.help_en: The agent request body template, which is required in agent mode and supports {{variable name}} placeholders
fields.help_zh: Agent请求体模板（agent模式时必填，支持{{变量名}}）
fields.name: request_body_template

fields.help_en: The agent request header template, which is optional in agent mode and supports {{variable name}} placeholders
fields.help_zh: Agent 请求头模版（agent模式时非必填，支持{{变量名}})
fields.name: request_header_template

fields.help_en: The agent request method. Valid values: POST (default) and GET
fields.help_zh: Agent请求方法：POST（默认）/ GET
fields.name: request_method

parameters.help_en: The list of experiment configurations. When passed, the entire list is replaced. The number of items must be between 1 and 5
parameters.help_zh: 实验配置列表。传入时整体替换，数量须为 1-5
parameters.name: experiments

parameters.help_en: The name of the associated data processing pipeline. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, the association is not updated. If you specify an empty string, the association is removed. After the association is established, when an experiment under this plan completes and writes experiment results to a Logstore, the system filters the data by the traceId of the current experiment trace and calls PreviewPipeline to write the pipeline-processed trace results together with the experiment results
parameters.help_zh: 关联的数据处理Pipeline名称（可选；不传表示不更新，传空字符串表示解除关联）。关联后，该计划下的实验执行完成写实验结果Logstore时，会按本次实验轨迹的traceId过滤并调用PreviewPipeline，将轨迹经Pipeline处理后的结果一并写入
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the experiment plan
parameters.name: plan_name

parameters.help_en: The custom query SQL clause in partial dataset mode
parameters.help_zh: 部分数据集模式下的自定义查询 SQL 子句
parameters.name: query_sql

parameters.help_en: The list of selected data item IDs in partial dataset mode. Passing an empty array clears the list
parameters.help_zh: 部分数据集模式下选定的数据项 ID 列表。传空数组表示清空
parameters.name: selected_item_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the experiment plan
parameters.name: plan_id

planId.description_en: The ID of the experiment plan

status.description_en: The update result. A value of updated indicates success

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. Unspecified fields remain unchanged
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。未传字段保持不变
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The request body. Unspecified fields remain unchanged
v1_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。未传字段保持不变
v1_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the experiment plan
v1_parameters.name: planId
